liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Seastones (Phil & Ned)** (2 reviews): Listener praises the performance, noting it is nice to hear Ned and the band make music; Ned plays electric piano lead, and Jerry bends strings differently, creating serious symmetry in the performance [9][20]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Opening Scarlet Begonias is extended and packed with great jamming, highlighted in the first set [17]
- **Playing in the Band** (1 review): A 23-minute set-closing performance features jazzy excursions and dynamic interplay, noted as a highlight [17]
- **U.S. Blues* (AUD Only)** (1 review): Second set ends with an audience patch of Sunshine Daydream and an encore of U.S. Blues [14]
- **Stronger Than Dirt** (1 review): Listener argues the jam is not Stronger Than Dirt, but a common 1974 Eyes of the World variation [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-09-11.132458.mtx.GEMS-BCE.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 26 songs; 226 min; rated 4.17/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd1974-09-11.sbd.unknown.4647.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 215 min; rated 4.08/5 by 13 [3]. Said about its sound: Described as classic 1974 sound; feedback is present, unlike newer cleaner amplifiers which removed it; Sound quality is rated great, offering a view of Jerry when he was young and healthy [9][15]
- **gd1974-09-11.sbd.bertha-ashley.7365.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 191 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [6]. Said about its sound: Scarlet Begonias drops out between 2:05 and 3:10 due to technical problems in the original recording [6]
- **gd1974-09-11.sbd.hamilton.3190.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 191 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: Major sound system and mix problems occur between 2:06 and 3:10 on the first disc; The fourth disc cuts at Sunshine Daydream, and discs two and four are short to preserve original playing [7]
- **gd1974-09-11.sbd.partial.cribbs.121207.flac16**: soundboard; 6 songs; 74 min; rated 4.44/5 by 9 [8]. Said about its sound: Sound is as good as any 1974 soundboard, described as a remarkable chunk cleaned up nicely [20]

## Around the show

- Listener reacts with excitement to the performance of Sugaree, Playin', Eyes, and Space [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-09-11.132458.mtx.GEMS-BCE.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 3 source matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard 1(Shnid:012183) Candelario Matrix MSR > D> CD; Soundboard 2(Shnid:121207) SBD > Master Reel > DAT > Sonic Solutions >… [1]. Also: The date is featured on Dick's Picks 7, with show information embedded in the flac headers [1]
- **gd1974-09-11.sbd.unknown.4647.shnf**: source: Reel master > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN [3]. Also: Identified as a matrix of Dick's Picks, containing what is claimed to be the first Stronger Than Dirt; Uploader notes explain the process, contradicting claims that the source is from Dick's Picks [10][11]
- **gd1974-09-11.sbd.bertha-ashley.7365.shnf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: Bertha Remaster of Master Reel source [6]. Also: Digitally remastered in 2001 using a custom Dual-DAW nicknamed Bertha by an archive.org user [6]
- **gd1974-09-11.sbd.hamilton.3190.shnf**: transferred by Seth Kaplan and G.S. Hamilton; source: SBD > DAT > CDR [7]
- **gd1974-09-11.sbd.partial.cribbs.121207.flac16**: transferred by Sean Cribbs; source: Partial SBD > Master Reel > DAT > Sonic Solutions > DAT > CD > FLAC [8]. Also: This sequence is missing from Dick's Picks 7 due to space limitations but is now available [19]
